description: Use this skill to create subject-neutral images and videos in an analog occultism / industrial CRT noir aesthetic: near-monochrome archival technical atmosphere, severe low-key lighting, tactile signal degradation, industrial geometry, and quiet unresolved tension. Use for portraits, products, environments, interfaces, diagrams, abstract forms, stills, and motion. Do not use for colorful cyberpunk, vaporwave, glossy advertising, conventional horror, or clean digital renders.
